svg.text: Cut two 60 mm lengths of 30 x 30 x 3 angle; square and deburr the ends.

svg.text: Plate leg (goes flat on the bracket plate): two 6.6 mm holes, 12 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: in from its free edge, 12 and 48 mm up from the bottom end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Arm leg (lies along the arm's side): two 6.6 mm holes, 15 mm out from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the face that sits on the plate, 20 and 40 mm up from the bottom end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Left and right cleats are mirror images: drill them clamped as a pair.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: plate legs flat on the plate front, 345 to 405 mm up it, arm legs

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 40 mm apart; two M6 bolts each through the plate (nuts behind);

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the arm slides between the arm legs and two M6 bolts with crush

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: sleeves pass through cleat, arm and cleat.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: both cleats square to the plate, arm legs parallel, 40 mm apart.
